hero.trustHtml: 100% client-side conversion. Your data never leaves your browser.

faq.question: Is my YAML data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All conversion happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON back to YAML?
faq.answer: Yes. Use our JSON to YAML converter to convert JSON back to YAML format.

faq.question: Does it support multi-document YAML?
faq.answer: The converter processes single YAML documents. For multi-document YAML, convert each document separately.

faq.question: Can I convert large YAML files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

faq.question: What YAML features are supported?
faq.answer: The converter supports standard YAML features including anchors, aliases, multi-line strings, and nested structures.

faq.question: 我的 YAML 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有转换在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。

faq.question: 可以把 JSON 转回 YAML 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。使用我们的 JSON 转 YAML 转换器将 JSON 转回 YAML 格式。

faq.question: 支持多文档 YAML 吗？
faq.answer: 转换器处理单个 YAML 文档。对于多文档 YAML，请分别转换每个文档。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 YAML 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。

faq.question: 支持哪些 YAML 特性？
faq.answer: 支持标准 YAML 特性，包括锚点、别名、多行字符串和嵌套结构。
